subject: Pricing followup - target price benchmarking vs OpenAI/Anthropic/other hosts
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for the call  quick pricing clarification and next steps

Hi Jamie / Samir 

Thanks again for the time today. Good high-level alignment on the integration and latency targets  appreciate you walking through the primary workloads. Per our ask, I wanted to confirm a few pricing/volume specifics so Marissa and Aditya can put together a tight cost model and draft proposal: 

- Estimated monthly token volume (avg + peak): you mentioned ~500M tokens/month baseline with spikes to ~1.5B during peak campaigns  can you confirm those numbers or share any sample daily-volume files? (the team attached a token sample schema for convenience)
- Token mix: what % do you expect to be short prompts (<128 tokens) vs long (>=1024 tokens)? Even rough percentages help a lot.
- Target unit economics: you mentioned target pricing around $/1M tokens  what is the target range that would make this a go for procurement (e.g., <$15/1M, $1012/1M, etc.)?
- Contract preferences: 12 vs 24 month commit? Are reserved capacity/SLAs required day one?

Next steps from our side: Marissa will run a comparative unit-cost model vs OpenAI/Anthropic and common open-model hosts (including quantized-host costs). We'll share a short model and a draft proposal (PDF) with recommended options: hosted API, reserved Dedicated pool, and a private deployment estimate.

If you can reply with the rough token mix and confirm the 500M baseline and budget range, that would be great  I can get you a draft by Tue EOD.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Attachments: acme_token_sample.csv (schema), redwood-pricing-worksheet-template.xlsx (stub)

From: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks for the call  quick pricing clarification and next steps

Hi Vanessa 

Thanks  quick answers inline: 
- Confirmed baseline: ~500M tokens/month (steady-state). Peak: up to ~1.41.6B tokens/month for marketing bursts, unlikely to be sustained but possible for 24 day windows.
- Token mix (rough): ~65% short prompts (<128 tokens), ~25% mid (1281024), ~10% long (>=1024).
- Budget / target pricing: Procurement is targeting $1013 / 1M tokens for hosted API-style pricing to be competitive with our current provider. If you can get to <$10/1M on committed reserved pricing, that will make the commercial team very interested.
- Contract: Prefer 12 month with option to convert to a reserved commit after Q2 usage is validated. SLA not required day one but must be available as an option.

I'll attach a small daily-volume extract for April  it's a CSV (see attached). Let me know if you need more granularity.

Thanks,
Jamie
Director of AI Product  ACME Corp
jamie.torres@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

Attachments: acme_daily_volume_apr.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing model inputs  quick benchmarking notes

Folks 

Thanks for the data, Jamie. I ran a quick back-of-envelope unit-cost comparison to align on benchmarking assumptions before we draft the formal proposal. Key assumptions: 65/25/10 token mix (short/mid/long) and 500M sustained monthly tokens. I included peak handling as burst capacity in the notes. High-level numbers (hosted API equivalent, $/1M tokens):

- OpenAI (public pricing, conversational + prompt mix): ~$1822 / 1M tokens (depends on prompt/model mix and context window)
- Anthropic (public pricing from current list): ~$1620 / 1M tokens for comparable chat endpoints
- Typical open-model hosts (quantized, multi-tenant optimized): ~$612 / 1M tokens depending on batch/kv cache effectiveness and whether you use dedicated reserved pools
- Redwood (hosted API, without reserved commit): target competitive range of $913 / 1M tokens for this workload given the mix (we can often achieve ~$79 / 1M with committed reserved capacity or a Dedicated plan with caching and batching optimizations)

Notes: The biggest delta vs OpenAI/Anthropic is that open-model hosts can hit lower marginal costs when you accept slightly higher latency or manage more of the infra (e.g., private deploys or dedicated quantized pools). Redwood's differentiator is predictable tail latency and built-in caching that reduces token consumption on repeat prompts.

Action: Vanessa, I'll draft the comparative table and two price options: a Hosted API quote at $11 / 1M tokens (12 mo, tiered volume pricing) and a Dedicated reserved option with effective $8 / 1M (12 mo commit, burst capacity added). We can include a Private deployment CAPEX/OPEX estimate if they'd prefer to manage infra.

-Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Quoted attachments: quick-benchmarks.xlsx (stub)

2) Can you confirm any additional fees (ingress/egress, storage for KV cache snapshots, logging/retention add-ons)?

If you can get the PDF over by EOD tomorrow, I'll loop in procurement and legal to start a 12 month PO.
